$comment: Phase 14 (0.1.2) Task 0 provider-enrichment scope gate. Machine-checkable source of truth consumed by Tasks 1-6 of plans/014-Release-0-1-2-Alibaba-Provider-Enrichment.md: the allowed provider-alibaba enrichment surfaces, the forbidden core/package/native-endpoint items, the additive-only compat promise, the audit/signed-tag/provenance policy, per-task evidence tokens, and the enrichment-freeze deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json and 0.1.2 changes none of it. Amendment requires a recorded deviation entry below. Validated by scripts/phase14-freeze.test.mjs. Baseline evidence for regression comparison at the Task 6 exit gate lives in scripts/phase14-baseline.json.

deviations.change: document input deferred: verification (2026-08-10) shows no OpenAI-compatible document content part exists; the compatible path is the OpenAI Files API (POST {base}/files, purpose=file-extract, <=150 MB) plus a fileid://<id> system-message reference (qwen-long, <=100 files) — an upload + status lifecycle, not a serialization mapping
deviations.rationale: roadmap 0.1.2 names document/video input; video input ships (video_url part); document input is recorded in docs/providers/alibaba.md as a demand-gated follow-up rather than a half-surface upload lifecycle in 0.1.2

deviations.change: rerank deferred: no OpenAI-compatible rerank route on the public presets (verified 2026-08-10); the compatible route is workspace-dedicated only (POST {workspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-api/v1/reranks, qwen3-rerank, <=500 docs, 4000 tokens/item, base path compatible-api/v1)
deviations.rationale: roadmap 0.1.2 names rerank as conditional on Task 1 verification; the defer branch is active — createAlibabaReranker over the workspace-dedicated route is recorded as a demand-gated future (caller-supplied baseUrl + rerank need)

compat.promise: additive-only declaration deltas vs scripts/compat-baseline across 0.1.x patch releases; zero breaking deltas at the 0.1.2 bump

supportMatrix: frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json (0.1.x compatibility and support matrix: Node, PostgreSQL, platform, provider, protocol pins, unsupported combinations); 0.1.2 changes none of it
